name: Mahtab
author: saqib33w
description: A wallpaper clock with a stylized faux-kana weekday and a family of ported Ryoku time faces, plus an optional twelve-style cava audio visualizer, highly inspired by the Kronos Omarchy plugin.

barWidget.description: Toggle the wallpaper Mahtab clock on or off; right-click for settings.

schema.label: Show clock
schema.description: Master visibility toggle for the wallpaper clock.

schema.label: 24-hour clock
schema.description: Show the hour in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour.

schema.label: Show seconds
schema.description: Show the seconds where the layout has room for them.

schema.label: Layout style
schema.description: Presentation style: mahtab (greeting card with a faux-kana weekday), grand (editorial serif), digital, minimal, analog, flip, rings, bighour, metal, column, outline, or banner.

schema.label: Show date
schema.description: Stack a date strip centred under the time.

schema.label: Date style
schema.description: Date strip design: inline (one caption), badge (accent chip), or stacked (torn-calendar).

schema.label: Bar padding
schema.description: Extra inset from the Omarchy bar. 0 auto-detects when the bar shares the same edge.

schema.label: Show card
schema.description: Draw a rounded card behind the clock for readability on busy wallpapers.

schema.label: Text shadow
schema.description: Draw a soft halo behind the time and date so they stay legible on busy wallpapers.

schema.label: Card color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for the card. Empty uses the theme background.

schema.label: Card opacity
schema.description: Card background opacity from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).

schema.label: Ink color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for text, rules, and the kana weekday. Empty uses the theme foreground.

schema.label: Font
schema.description: Family for the greeting and date. Empty uses the Omarchy shell font.

schema.label: Show on
schema.description: Which monitors display the clock: all, primary, focused, or external.

schema.label: Audio visualizer
schema.description: Draw a cava audio spectrum on the wallpaper, behind your windows.

schema.label: Visualizer style
schema.description: Spectrum look: bars, split, dots, segments, wave, ribbon, curtain, line, frame, radial, orb, or spiral.

schema.label: Visualizer shape
schema.description: Band cap style: rounded or sharp.

schema.label: Visualizer color
schema.description: Bar color: accent (theme accent), foreground (theme text), rainbow, or white.

schema.label: Visualizer height
schema.description: Height of the tallest bars, in pixels.

schema.label: Visualizer bars
schema.description: Number of spectrum bands.

schema.label: Visualizer width
schema.description: Share of the screen width the spectrum spans, from 0.1 to 1.

schema.label: Visualizer thickness
schema.description: Band width as a share of its slot, from 0.05 to 1.

schema.label: Visualizer glow
schema.description: Bloom around each band, from 0 to 1.

schema.label: Visualizer reflection
schema.description: Mirror the bars below the baseline, from 0 to 1.

schema.label: Visualizer segments
schema.description: Slices per band for the Segments style, from 3 to 24.

schema.label: Visualizer peak caps
schema.description: Draw falling caps above each bar (Bars and Segments).

schema.label: Visualizer sensitivity
schema.description: Amplitude multiplier applied to every bar.

schema.label: Visualizer opacity
schema.description: Peak opacity of the bars, from 0 to 1.

schema.label: Visualizer bottom margin
schema.description: Distance from the bottom screen edge, in pixels.
